title: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
summary: Ask the U.S. government's new AI chatbot about Minecraft and it produces a roughly 1,800-word bureaucratic remix of the game's ending poem. It's an easter egg, not a hallucination.

title: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
summary: The two proposals would define event contracts as "swaps" while excluding "casino-style gambling products"—a bid to cement the agency's exclusive jurisdiction as states sue prediction-market operators over gambling claims.
